module: Example extension (file comment: "an example of how you could add things into jbeam loading") showing how to hook into the two JBeam loading phases. Both hooks just write a level I log line ("onJbeamLoadingPhase1/2 called :)"). It is not loaded by default: an extensions.load('jbeam_jbeamMod') is needed (commented-out line in the file).
usage:
extensions.load('jbeam_jbeamMod')
-- then copy the module and replace the log() calls with your own JBeam data processing
notes: None of the hook arguments are used in the code; their exact meaning comes from the calling code (not read here).
The log names use the tag 'extensions.jbeam.jbeamMod'.

onJbeamLoadingPhase1.desc: Hook called during phase 1 of a vehicle's JBeam loading. Here: only writes a log "onJbeamLoadingPhase1 called :)".

objID.desc: Not used (inferred from the name: vehicle object id).

vehicleConfig.desc: Not used (inferred from the name: vehicle configuration).

onJbeamLoadingPhase2.desc: Hook called during phase 2 of a vehicle's JBeam loading. Here: only writes a log "onJbeamLoadingPhase2 called :)".

objID.desc: Not used (inferred from the name: vehicle object id).

vehicleConfig.desc: Not used (inferred from the name: vehicle configuration).
